title: Reconstruction of cosmic-ray direction and energy in radio arrays using deep ensemble graph neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2602.23321v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Using advanced machine learning techniques, we developed a method to reconstruct the arrival direction and energy of ultra-high-energy cosmic rays from the voltage traces they induce on ground-based radio detector arrays.   In our approach, triggered antennas are represented as a graph structure, which serves as input for a graph neural network (GNN). By incorporating physical knowledge into both the GNN architecture and the input data, we improve the precision and reduce the required size of the training set with respect to a fully data-driven approach. This method achieves an angular resolution of 0.092 degrees and an electromagnetic energy reconstruction resolution of 16.4% on simulated data with realistic noise conditions.   We also employ uncertainty estimation methods to enhance the reliability of our predictions, quantifying the confidence of the GNN's outputs and providing confidence intervals for both direction and ene

translated_title: 使用深度集成图神经网络在射电阵列中重建宇宙线方向和能量
translated_abstract: 利用先进的机器学习技术，我们开发了一种方法，可以从超高能宇宙线在地面射电探测器阵列上感应产生的电压波形中重建其到达方向和能量。在我们的方法中，被触发的天线被表示为图结构，作为图神经网络（GNN）的输入。通过在GNN架构和输入数据中融入物理知识，与完全数据驱动的方法相比，我们提高了精度并减少了所需的训练集规模。该方法在具有真实噪声条件的模拟数据上实现了0.092度的角分辨率和16.4%的电磁能量重建分辨率。我们还采用不确定性估计方法来提高预测的可靠性，量化GNN输出的置信度，并为方向和能量提供置信区间。
tldr: 该论文提出一种将物理知识融入深度集成图神经网络的方法，从地面射电阵列的电压数据中重建超高能宇宙线的方向和能量，在真实噪声条件下实现了0.092度的角分辨率和16.4%的能量分辨率，并通过不确定性估计提供置信区间。
en_tdlr: A physics-informed deep ensemble graph neural network is developed to reconstruct the direction and energy of ultra-high-energy cosmic rays from radio array voltage traces, achieving 0.092° angular resolution and 16.4% energy resolution under realistic noise conditions with uncertainty estimation.
